originalStoredRecord.summary: Fixed-wing UAV recovered near Porvoo/Pellinge, Finland. Preliminary assessment indicates mapping or surveillance use. No explosive payload reported. Origin and operator remain unknown. Possible territorial violation under investigation.

evidence.observed: Physical fixed-wing UAV recovered; several metres in size; authorities reported no explosive payload.
evidence.assessed: Preliminary mapping or surveillance function; exact role remains under investigation.

state.latestAssessment: No recent information confirms that this situation remains active. Last source assessment: The Border Guard identified the Porvoo/Pellinge device as a Russian-made Geoscan 701. Its operator was not confirmed. Authorities continued investigating; the President said there was no immediate threat.
